The '''Jestan system''' was situated in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Corpheli sector/Legends|Corpheli sector]], a part of both the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of that region.<ref name="Location" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located on a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the [[Belukat system/Legends|Belukat]] and [[Corphelion system/Legends|Corphelion systems]],<ref name="EGTW" /> and it contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jestan]].<ref name="CSWE" /> 

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a [[Engagement at Jestan|major battle]]<ref name="CSWE" /> of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> was fought on Jestan.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Jestan system was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]]. In 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], the New Republic dispatched the [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|fleet carrier]] [[Endurance (Endurance-class)|''Endurance'']] to participate in a [[Orinda campaign|military campaign]] against the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. To that end, the ''Endurance'' traveled from the Corphelion system to the Belukat system, passing through the Jestan system in the process.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jestan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="Location" />
